prompt:
You are an associate analyst in the Equity Research group at Brennan Brothers & Co. Managing Director Lin Wei-chen has asked you to prepare a full margin variance analysis on Home Depot (HD) ahead of an upcoming institutional client meeting. HD's most recent annual filing just dropped — the company reported $164.7B in revenue, $54.9B gross profit, $20.9B operating income, and $14.2B net income for the fiscal year ended early February 2026, with SG&A of $30.7B. Lin wants a clear picture of how each margin moved versus the prior comparable period and what drove the changes.

Build a self-contained Excel workbook that does the following:

Calculate HD's gross margin, operating margin, and net margin for the current fiscal year and the prior full fiscal year. Quantify the year-over-year change in both basis points and percentage points. Decompose the gross margin bridge into revenue and COGS drivers — to the extent the filing's segment and product-mix disclosures allow, attribute the variance to price, volume, and mix. For the operating margin, build a line-item bridge showing SG&A's contribution versus gross profit and any other operating items. Then reconcile from operating margin down to net margin using interest, tax, and other below-the-line items. If quarterly data is available in the filing, also present a sequential quarterly view.

Each material variance needs a 2-3 sentence written interpretation referencing HD's segment or geographic disclosures where available. Flag any non-recurring or unusual items that distort comparability.

The workbook needs a Summary tab with the headline margin bridges, a Detailed Bridge tab with the full decomposition, a Source Data tab where every figure traces back to its EDGAR line item using XBRL tag names, and an Assumptions tab documenting your methodology. Use billions for dollar amounts, one decimal for percentages, whole numbers for basis points. Apply the firm's standard green/red/grey color coding for favorable/unfavorable/neutral variances. Include a cover page tab with the analysis title, your name, date, and the confidentiality disclaimer.

I've attached HD's five-year historical financials for reference. A few things to watch: the pinned EDGAR data includes a 2010 revenue figure ($52.9B) — that is legacy data, not your prior-year comparable, so do not use it. Confirm which fiscal year the Feb 2026 dating represents (FY2025 ending ~Feb 1, 2026) before labeling your periods. Also note that the May 7 EDGAR filing (PX14A6G) is a proxy statement, not the 10-K itself — pull all income statement data from the actual annual report.

reference_answer.narrative_prompt:
You are an associate analyst at an investment bank. You have built a 5-year unlevered DCF model for THE HOME DEPOT, INC. (HD) based on its latest SEC filings.

The model includes:
- Base-year financials from EDGAR XBRL
- Revenue growth assumption of 4.3% (sector-typical for retail)
- WACC of 4.43% derived from beta=1.16, Rf=4.35%, ERP=5.50%
- Terminal growth of 1.90%

Write a one-page summary memo explaining the key assumptions and valuation conclusion. Be specific with numbers. Do NOT use AI hedging.
